executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $190.27 per resident day (44.6% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $9,892,757 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 33,628 Medicaid days, $294.18 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $289.04 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $292.07 for July 2025 to June 2026.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -28.6% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $285,709, 4.0% of the $7,071,500 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,589,968, $42.78 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $720,853 (45.3%), allocated fringe $171,401 (10.8%), non-wage costs $697,714 (43.9%). Raw food was $669,382 ($18.01 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $607,300, $16.34 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $419,689 (69.1%), allocated fringe $99,792 (16.4%), non-wage costs $87,819 (14.5%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2020 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 10 line(s) of the report, a net reduction of $82,676 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Other Resident Care Supplies (page 20 line 5m), removed $46,559; Medical Director (page 13 line B8a), removed $18,167; Head Dietitian (page 10 line A5a), removed $10,398. Separately, the home itself removed $1,355,817 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
